subject: Operations
title: Healthcare.gov Launch Failure
description: A short lesson to help you apply Healthcare.gov Launch Failure.

hook.text: The US government launched Healthcare.gov in 2013. On day one, only 6 people successfully enrolled. Six.

buildup.text: The website was supposed to serve millions of Americans signing up for health insurance under the Affordable Care Act.

discovery.text: The site crashed under load. It was built by 55 contractors with no single integrator and no end-to-end testing.

twist.text: Warning signs appeared months before launch. Officials ignored them and insisted on the October 1 deadline.

climax.text: A rescue team from Silicon Valley rebuilt critical systems in weeks. The site stabilized by December.

punchline.text: 55 contractors, no testing, one deadline. Recipe for failure.

quiz.question: How many people enrolled on Healthcare.gov's first day?
